\chapter{Bet sizes and game parameters}\label{app:game}

All amounts are in big blinds. Raise totals round to the nearest $0.1\bb$ (halves away from zero) and are capped at the stack. The sizes are those of the reference charts \cite{pokertrainer}. A single out-of-position 4-bet multiplier cannot reproduce both of the charts' sizes of $19$ and $23$ after rounding; $2.55$ gives $19.1$ and $23$.

\begin{table}[ht]
\centering\small
\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}llX@{}}
\toprule
Action & Rule & Examples \\
\midrule
Open & $2.5$; $3$ from SB & UTG opens to $2.5$; SB opens to $3$ \\
3-bet in position & $3\times$ the open & BTN vs a CO open: $7.5$; BB vs an SB open: $9$ \\
3-bet from the blinds & $5\times$ the open & BB vs a BTN open: $12.5$ \\
Squeeze & as a 3-bet, $+1$ open per caller & BTN vs HJ open, CO call: $10$; BB vs CO open, two calls: $17.5$ \\
4-bet in position & $2\times$ the 3-bet & BTN vs BB's $12.5$: $25$ \\
4-bet out of position & $2.55\times$ the 3-bet & CO vs BTN's $7.5$: $19.1$; SB vs BB's $9$: $23$ \\
5-bet & all-in & $100$ \\
\midrule
Stacks, blinds & $100$; $0.5/1$ & reset every hand \\
Rake & $5\%$ of the pot, capped at $4$ & only if a flop is dealt or an all-in is called \\
Limping & not allowed & \\
Cold calls & of an open only & a cold caller may also call a squeeze \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\caption{Bet sizes and rules of the game.}
\label{tab:betsizes}
\end{table}

\chapter{Fitted realization parameters}\label{app:params}

\Cref{tab:param-values} lists the realization parameters (\cref{tab:params}) at three points: the values found by the coordinate search of \cref{sec:tuning}, the optimum of the fixed-strategy fit at temperature $\tau = 1$ (\cref{sec:fixed-fit}), and the adopted values, halfway between the two (\cref{sec:res-fit}). The scale is fixed by $\alpha_{\mathrm{ip}} = 1$.

\chapter{Further range charts}\label{app:charts}

This appendix shows, for fourteen spots, the Scratch solve next to the GTO and PTO charts of \textcite{pokertrainer}, with the distance $D$ of the Scratch solve to each chart (\cref{sec:reference}). Conventions are as in \cref{fig:grids-a}: raise in red, call in green, fold in grey, and white for hands the player never brings to the spot. In the chart grids the reach is the chart's own.
